verdict.rationale: Clara documents a REST API with an OpenAPI schema and guides for retrieving and reconciling transactions. Authentication is described only as dashboard-managed credentials that expire per project, with mTLS shown in a code example. Nothing in the pack covers OAuth, scoped tokens, or API access to receipts and expense reports. Missing for 10: OAuth flow documentation, scoped token permissions, receipt retrieval endpoints, expense/expense-report endpoints, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull transactions, expenses, and receipts through a documented REST API with OAuth and scoped tokens

citations.quote: REST API for programmatic access to corporate cards, transactions, users, invoices, and spend management across Mexico, Brazil, and Colombia.
Pull all transactions for a billing period, match them to the billing statement, categorize with labels, and export to your accounting system.
The following example retrieves your 10 most recent transactions.
API credentials are managed directly from the Clara dashboard — no need to contact support for each new project.
